name: Wrong concept / irrelevant clinical answer
proposal: Broaden intent normalization for paraphrases and grammar variants, keep financial/residence/coverage timelines distinct from clinical questions, and require the requested fact rather than any true fact.

name: Invented facts or unsupported restrictions
proposal: Validate unsupported assertions as well as missing required facts, including free-text additions and statements about family transport, residence, dates, finances and coverage ownership.

name: Combined-question or family-reference gaps
proposal: Track every requested slot and bind pronouns to the established person/concept; require completion of both insurance/dentist and other combined questions.

name: Unsupported uncertainty about known facts
proposal: Use unknown-information replies only for unspecified facts; apply complete fact checks to alternate willingness, option and reliability formulations.

name: Payment ability versus willingness
proposal: Preserve the zero-payment boundary across small-fee, reduced-fee, copayment and affordability phrasing. Separate ability to pay from preference or willingness; combined free-clinic/ability questions need both parts.

name: Ambiguous responses retained for human review
proposal: Review these examples before changing behavior; refine evaluator criteria only with explicit documented justification, without weakening the current regression matchers.
